title: Tensor-Hom unit agrees with ordinary Hom evaluation at one
statement: For every small ringed site (C,J,O) and ordinary complex N, the map ringedComplexHomUnit O N, defined as the transpose of the tensor left unitor for the signed ordinary Hom adjunction, is precisely the inverse of ringedHomUnitEvaluationIso O N from [def-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-system]. This statement concerns arbitrary N and no Koszul diagram, finite evaluation or tower.

proof.text: For a sheaf A, transpose its tensor left unitor using the explicit sheafification adjunction. The strong monoidal left-unit law identifies the underlying uncurried map with the sheafified presheaf left unitor followed by the counit. The adjunction cancels the counit; evaluation of the resulting localized linear map at one returns the original section. Thus curry(leftUnitor) followed by homObjUnitIso.hom is the identity.

Cancel the Hom-unit evaluation isomorphism and compare degree n maps. Its only relevant source component is degree zero, where the signed transpose formula of ringedComplexCurry_component has sign (-1)^(0*n)=1. Move the canonical unit-complex degree-zero identification through curry_pre_app. The leftUnitor_inv_f formula identifies that tensor summand with the sheaf left unitor. Apply the sheaf calculation of step one.
